_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 06 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain adds a filterable index of ThreeWayMatch records — the visible artefact of the matching engine. The page is registered as a kind=page custom component in src/registry.js because the standard generated index does not render per-row match-status pills or the quick-action 'evaluate again' button this view exposes. Adds the matching-engine entry under the Purchase Orders menu so the AP team can navigate from PO list → invoice list → match list.
